title: Make BCQuality documentation easier for partners to get started
summary: BCQuality documentation is reorganized to guide partners through practical first-use paths, leading with CLI prerequisites and plugin installation rather than internal architecture. Sample references across knowledge articles become clickable links, and the Community Agents review gains folder-path support.
key_points: README restructured with task-based navigation for partners
491 sample references converted to clickable links across 253 articles
New focused guides for usage, troubleshooting, customization, and contributing
Community Agents review extended with folder-path support
Architecture details moved to advanced references
quote: Lead the README with CLI prerequisites, plugin installation, an app-review example, expected outcomes, and task-based navigation.
